implementation_contract.public_boundary: A receipt declaring a public handoff requirement must carry a durable handoff reference, and repository integration may not fabricate PUBLIC_VERIFIED.

After integration, the workflow executes their base-owned copies for later candidates.
implementation_contract.meta_governance: Because this repair changes the trusted Steward workflow and introduces future protected integrity surfaces, qualification requires the explicit steward-meta-governance-reopen signal.
